verdict.rationale: Marqeta's Core API exposes transaction retrieval by card/merchant/account, webhooks for real-time event notifications, and JIT funding decisioning, which supports live money-movement visibility, but there is no documented settlement reporting or reconciliation feature that ties authorizations to clearing 'to the penny.' missing for 10: explicit settlement/clearing reconciliation reports, ledger balance statements, penny-accurate reconciliation tooling or account-balance dashboards for finance leads.
